channel.title: Architectural Digest India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Architectural Digest India (architecturaldigest.in)

item.title: An Indian wife's brief to designers helps transform this 1915 Tudor house with regional influences
item.description: Historic? Absolutely. Boring? Never. This 1915 vintage classic has been reimagined with bold patterns and vibrant hues.

item.title: Vikram Goyal launches Viya’s new flagship at Mumbai’s Trafford House
item.description: In its new chapter at South Mumbai’s historic Trafford House, Vikram Goyal’s Viya has expanded its craft-forward offerings to include soft furnishings and fashion.

item.title: How 7 creatives transformed their Bandra rentals into homes bursting with individuality
item.description: They may not own a house–but these renters in Bandra sure know how to build a home.

item.title: In this Chennai home, minimalism is about refinement, not reduction
item.description: Amrita Thomas of Alara Studio trades spectacle for quiet depth, using oak, stone and light to create a Chennai home that unfolds slowly and deliberately.

item.title: Inside Ghislaine Maxwell’s Upper East Side home and her disturbing collection of art
item.description: Currently serving a 20-year prison sentence at a federal facility in Bryan, Texas, Maxwell was long a fixture of New York society.

item.title: Are we falling back in love with handcrafted home decor?
item.description: From block prints to immersive handcrafted spaces, Zeba World shows why handcrafted home decor is making homes feel warmer, more personal, and infinitely more interesting again.

item.title: Gayatri Oberoi's 75,000-square-foot dream home in Juhu—designed by architect Piero Lissoni
item.description: The former actress opens doors to her nine-storey mansion in Mumbai with sweeping views of the Arabian Sea. Designed in a minimalist yet luxurious style, this is Italian master Piero Lissoni’s first private residential architecture and interiors project in India.

item.title: 9 bedside table design ideas worth taking notes from
item.description: These bedside table design elements demonstrate how a simple surface can anchor, soften or sharpen an entire bedroom.

item.title: In this Surat apartment, a matriarch’s kitchen becomes the home’s soul
item.description: A three-generation home by DOT weaves connection and light, elevating everyday rituals into intentional acts of design.

item.title: Harry Styles is one of only 11 residents calling this abandoned Italian village home
item.description: Nicknamed the “Dying City,” Civita di Bagnoregio is perched on a mountaintop in central Italy. While the historic village’s population is dwindling to only a handful of residents, Harry Styles is among those who have been charmed by it. In fact, he’s now the owner of a home there.
